goal: Let any worker combine concurrent text edits into a reviewable three-way merge without silently discarding either contributor's work.
Let any worker independently verify Ethereum account and storage proofs against a trusted block state root before relying on RPC-reported contract state.
Let any worker search an unfamiliar document collection offline and return ranked passages with exact source line citations.
Let any worker resolve a finite offline dependency catalog into compatible versions or an auditable explanation of why no solution exists.
